data.summary:
A **terrain area** holding any light or dense feature is **Obscuring**. Two models cannot see each other if each **line-of-sight** path between them passes through at least one Obscuring area, ignoring any area either model is in.

See [Visibility](vsdata:core-rule/visibility) for the line-of-sight test and **[Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover)** for the effect on eligible ranged attacks.

blocksVisibility.when: every line of sight between them crosses one or more Obscuring terrain areas
blocksVisibility.excluded: any Obscuring terrain area containing either or both of those models
blocksVisibility.result: the two models are not visible to each other

coverInteraction.use: not fully visible because of Obscuring terrain

diagram.heading: Hidden and Obscuring
diagram.case: two units with an Obscuring area between them; no model visible to the other

gdc.foldsDiagram: GDC sentences 2-6 carry the p51 heading and captions; sentence 5 rewords the detection-range caption
